## Prompt Details (if adding/updating prompts)

### Taxonomy Compliance

- [ ] **L1 - Role**: __________ (e.g., Student, Doctor, Developer)
- [ ] **L2 - Domain**: __________ (e.g., Education, Healthcare, Technology)
- [ ] **L3 - Skill Level**: __________ (e.g., Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced)
- [ ] **L4 - Intent**: __________ (EXPL, SUMM, DRAF, ANAL, TRNS, CREA, PLAN)
- [ ] **L5 - Tone**: __________ (Formal, Casual, Academic, Poetic, Pure Tamil, Tanglish)
- [ ] **L6 - Format**: __________ (Essay, Table, Bullet Points, Step-by-Step, Code)
- [ ] **L7 - Constraints**: __________ (e.g., 200 words max, specific language style)
- [ ] **L8 - Safety**: __________ (Disclaimers included if needed for health/law/finance)

### File Naming

- [ ] Filename follows pattern: `role-domain-skill-intent-tone.md` (all lowercase, kebab-case)
- [ ] Example: `student-edu-g6-expl-simple.md`

### Content Quality

- [ ] Prompt is clear and well-structured
- [ ] Examples are provided where appropriate
- [ ] Language is culturally appropriate and inclusive
- [ ] No PII, sensitive data, or copyrighted content
- [ ] Safety disclaimers included (if applicable)

## Testing

- [ ] I have tested this prompt with an AI model
- [ ] The output meets expectations
- [ ] No linting errors (markdown correct)
